plans.idea: Faithful centred column like the original: logo on top, a big bottle as the focal point, then a full-width headline with the legal line under it, and the flavour pills and Build Your Mix button grouped in one wide block near the bottom, all on one centre axis.

Headline-first story layout: logo, then a large two-line headline at the top so the message reads first, the bottle filling the middle band, and the pill group closing the column at the bottom as the action zone.

Product-and-menu split: logo top-left, the bottle on the left with the flavour pills stacked as a menu column to its right on the same top and bottom lines, then a full-width headline across the lower third, all sharing one left edge.
